messages:
eng-oncall-bot: Pager alert — genqueue latency spike in eu-west-1 for text-generation (p95 > 2500ms, count 18). Alert: <https://alerts.redwood.ai/5167894321|genqueue-eu-west-1>

sara-oncall: taking this. creating bridge and paging SRE. bridge: https://meet.redwood.ai/bridge/5167894321

mike-sre: joining. quick telemetry check: backlog building on shard gq-eu-3, CPU contention on worker pods visible. any recent deploys?

ellie-ops: pushing an initial status draft below for review — aim to publish within 10m if we agree.

ellie-ops: ```
We are currently investigating increased request latency for text generation in EU-West. Impact: limited number of customers may experience elevated latency for generation requests. We have activated fallback routing and are implementing mitigations. Next update in 15 minutes.
```

legal-bot: wording note — avoid vague "limited number" without context. prefer "a small number of customers" or include affected tiers. keep it conservative.

sam-support: from support side: 7 customers opened tickets, primarily high-concurrency workloads. embeddings and streaming endpoints seem unaffected so far. I'll prepare targeted outreach.

mike-sre: mitigation plan: 1) enable region fallback routing to dedicated eu-fallback pool, 2) scale genqueue workers + drain/restart gq-eu-3, 3) temporarily reduce KV-cache prewarming to reduce CPU spikes. starting step 1 now.

sara-oncall: rolling fallback to 10% -> 50% -> 100% on routing policy. observability dashboards pinned. runbook linked in bridge.

eng-oncall-bot: Config change applied: eu routing policy -> fallback 10% (cfg-id: cfg-9812)

mike-sre: queue depth dropping after 30s, p95 down from ~2500ms -> ~1200ms. proceeding with scale up.

ellie-ops: updated status draft to note mitigation step. new copy below for publish review:
```
We have implemented automated fallback routing to a dedicated pool which is expected to reduce latency for impacted requests. If you continue to see degraded performance, contact support@redwood.ai. Next update in 30 minutes.
```

legal-bot: approved with minor tweak — replace "expected to" with "is expected to"? current is fine. ensure no commitment to SLA change.

ellie-ops: publishing initial notice now. will link once live.

ellie-ops: (published) Initial status posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/5167894321 — tagging CS & Support for targeted outreach.

sam-support: noted. sending targeted emails to the 7 affected accounts with suggested workarounds (reduce batch size, retry backoff).

nate-product: do we need to flip any streaming canaries? does fallback affect streaming endpoints?

mike-sre: streaming telemetry looks normal — no action needed there. fallback only impacts generation routing.

sara-oncall: periodic update: fallback at 100%, queue depth normalized, p95 now ~350ms, still observing occasional spikes. ETA: 30m to verify stability, will keep bridge open.

ellie-ops: drafting update #2 for status page:
```
Mitigation in progress: traffic has been routed to the fallback pool. Latency has improved but some requests may still experience elevated response times. We are monitoring and will provide another update in 30 minutes or sooner.
```

legal-bot: l10n/wording check — ok.

eng-oncall-bot: Alert cleared: genqueue p95 back below threshold in eu-west (cleared at 5167894530).

sara-oncall: removing fallback and restoring normal routing now; will watch for regression for 10 minutes before resolving.

sara-oncall: no regressions observed for 12 minutes. marking as resolved. preparing resolved notice.

ellie-ops: Resolved copy ready:
```
Resolved — The latency spike affecting text generation in EU-West has been mitigated. Normal routing has been restored. If you continue to experience issues, contact support@redwood.ai.
```

sam-support: outreach completed for all affected customers; logged follow-ups.

mike-sre: RCA owner assigned: I'll collect timeline and root cause (likely queue backpressure on gq-eu-3) and propose preventive actions (adjust autoscale thresholds, improve throttling, add health checks).

sara-oncall: thanks team — bridge closed.

eng-oncall-bot: Bridge closed by sara-oncall. Duration: 00:45:23
